title: Preserving valueRight across sandwich view tree transforms in diff flame graphs
answers: Why does the diff flame graph tooltip show NaN% or undefined in sandwich view?
Why are baseline, comparison, or diff sample values NaN in Callers and Callees view?
How should valueRight be propagated when merging or rebasing flame graph subtrees?
body:
Symptom: Diff flame graph tooltips show NaN%, NaNundefined, or bare undefined for baseline, comparison, or diff values in sandwich view (Callers/Callees).
Root cause: packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:mergeSubtrees and packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/treeTransforms.ts:getParentSubtrees rebuild LevelItem nodes for sandwich views without recomputing or propagating valueRight, which packages/grafana-flamegraph/src/FlameGraph/FlameGraphTooltip.tsx:getDiffTooltipData dereferences with a non-null assertion.
Fix pattern: When aggregating or rebasing tree nodes for transformed views, sum or propagate valueRight alongside value if input items contain diff metrics, and default missing valueRight to 0 in tooltip calculations.
Constraints: valueRight should remain undefined for non-diff profiles (only set when at least one input node has valueRight !== undefined); applies whenever LevelItem nodes are rebuilt from existing trees.
applies: Flamegraph sandwich view and diff profile tooltip rendering in packages/grafana-flamegraph
